articles.headline: Olise double sees Bayern cruise in German Cup as Kane rested
articles.description: Bayern Munich did not need the services of Ballon d'Or winner Harry Kane and left the England captain on the bench as they cruised to a 6-1 German Cup victory over second-division side Magdeburg on Wednesday.

images.name: Bayern celeb vs Magdeburg_261028 [1296x729]
images.caption: Bayern Munich players celebrate after scoring a goal against Magdeburg in the German Cup.
images.alt: Bayern Munich players celebrate after scoring a goal against Magdeburg in the German Cup.

articles.headline: Bayern honor Kane for Ballon d'Or win before German Cup rout
articles.description: Ballon D'Or winner Harry Kane received a guard of honor from Bayern Munich before a German Cup second-round rout of second-tier FC Magdeburg on Wednesday.

images.name: Kane Bayern guard of honor_261028 [1296x729]
images.caption: Harry Kane is given a guard of honor by his Bayern Munich teammates ahead of their German Cup second-round game.
images.alt: Harry Kane is given a guard of honor by his Bayern Munich teammates ahead of their German Cup second-round game.

articles.headline: Bayern Munich's Vincent Kompany improving 'day by day,' but no return date yet
articles.description: Bayern Munich assistant coach Aaron Danks said head coach Vincent Kompany is in good spirits and improving "day by day" after being hospitalized last week.

images.name: Vincent Kompany [1296x729]
images.caption: Vincent Kompany collapsed at Bayern Munich's training ground last week.
images.alt: 21 October 2026, Bavaria, Munich: Soccer, Men: Champions League, Bayern Munich vs. Arsenal, group stage, Matchday 3 at the Allianz Arena. Coach Vincent Kompany (Bayern Munich) arrives at the stadium before the game

images.name: Harry Kane is crowned the 2026 Men's Ballon d'Or winner
images.caption: Harry Kane is crowned the 2026 Men's Ballon d'Or winner

articles.headline: Bayern 'know how to deal with' Jamal Musiala seizures - Vincent Kompany
articles.description: Bayern Munich coach Vincent Kompany says it wouldn't be "a big deal" if star attacking midfielder Jamal Musiala were to collapse again as he copes with a neurological issue which causes seizures.

articles.headline: Bayern boss Kompany won't 'pressure' Musiala after collapses
articles.description: Bayern Munich coach Vincent Kompany said Wednesday that Jamal Musiala could be available to play soon, but added he wouldn't pressure the Germany star to return to the field until he was ready.

article.story:
Bayern Munich did not need the services of Ballon d'Or winner Harry Kane and left the England captain on the bench as they cruised to a 6-1 German Cup victory over second-division side Magdeburg on Wednesday.

Michael Olise and Ismael Saibari were on target in the first half as Munich went into the interval 2-1 up and an Olise penalty and further goals from Alphonso Davies, Nathaniel Brown and David Santos Daiber wrapped it up.

Mateusz Zukowski had levelled for the visitors with a fine strike from distance.

Bayern Munich went ahead in the 10th minute with a smart move that carved Magdeburg open. Lennart Karl's precise throughball sent Saibari clean through the middle and after he drew goalkeeper Dominik Reimann he rolled the ball across to the supporting Olise, who had the easiest of tasks to finish into the empty net.

However, the lead only last five minutes before the visitors were level when Zukowski picked the ball up wide on the left flank and cut inside on to his right foot and fired an unstoppable effort beyond Jonas Urbig into the far corner of the net.

Olise returned the favour as Bayern retook the lead with 21 minutes on the clock. The former Crystal Palace frontman spotted the run of Saibari and his pass through was inch-perfect for the Morocco midfielder to lift over the advancing Reimann and into the net.

Olise doubled his tally five minutes after the interval when he converted from the penalty spot after Davies was brought down in the box.

Bayern then put the game to bed as the second-tier side ran out of steam.

Karl broke clear on the right side of the box and his ball across the face of goal was converted by Davies at the back post in the 70th minute and Brown pounced on a loose ball to steer home a left-footed shot with 73 minutes gone.

Portugal Under-20 international Santos Daiber added a sixth in stoppage time.
